_about: B01 restore completion counts for the providers category, shared by the iOS and Android tests. local/remote use the provider_config.json wire shape of b01_restore_scenarios.json. credentialsWritten = instance ids whose credential the restore wrote over a different value. Unit = the package's instances: new -> imported, content really changed (fields, a model entry added/changed, a credential written) -> updated once, otherwise skipped ('up to date'). Groups count on top: a restored group -> imported, a changed or same-name-merged group -> updated, an unchanged group is not counted.

identical.about: Backup identical to this device: everything up to date (must not regress to the 93cad55ae 'Updated N' false reading).

instance_field_changed.about: Same-id instance whose label the backup changes.

entry_parameter_changed.about: A model's parameters replaced by the backup's: its instance is updated.

entry_hidden_changed.about: A model's hidden state replaced by the backup's.

entry_added_to_existing_instance.about: The backup brings a model this device's instance lacks.

credential_written.about: The backup's API key written over a different one (credentialsWritten comes from the credential restore).

instance_changed_several_ways.about: Fields, a model and the key of one instance all change: counted once.

new_instance.about: An instance this device does not have is imported; its key being written does not also make it updated.

local_only_instance_ignored.about: An instance only on this device is not part of the package and not counted.

group_restored.about: A group deleted on this device comes back: imported.

group_content_changed.about: A same-id group whose content the backup changes: updated.

same_name_merge.about: A backup group with this device's group name and another id merges into the local one: updated even when the content matched.

device_repro_2026_10_15.about: The Pixel 4a run: group deleted, a model renamed and the key changed on the device, then the backup restored. Was imported=0 updated=0 skipped=27.

created_at_precision_only.about: Only createdAt differs, by the milliseconds an iOS package drops: not content, so still up to date.
